answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 45889 Country: India Title: Name Question: We have kept our daughter name Arzoo Alaika so please suggest me is it good name to keep and also if it is available in Islamic name and the meaning of Alaika. Answer ID: 45889 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1052/687/L=1434) Arzoo means ambition, desire. This name is correct; however the word Alaika is meaningless hence it is better for you to keep only the name Arzoo for your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
